**Page:** 2012 NAPLAN Summary (Preliminary) Report – https://www.nap.edu.au/_resources/2012_NAPLAN_Summary_(Preliminary)_Report.PDF  

**Evidence**  
| Subject | 2012 National Average (Mean Scale) | 2012 Participation (%) | Source Quote |
|---------|------------------------------------|------------------------|--------------|
| Reading | 541.3 | 94.2% | “Mean scale … Aust 541.3 … Participation 94.2” |
| Persuasive Writing | 519.5 | 90.2% | “Mean scale … Aust 519.5 … Participation 90.2” |
| Spelling | 544.1 | 94.0% | “Mean scale … Aust 544.1 … Participation 94.0” |
| Grammar and Punctuation | 558.0 | 95.0% | “Mean scale … Aust 558.0 … Participation 95.0” |
| Numeracy | 546.2 | 93.7% | “Mean scale … Aust 546.2 … Participation 93.7” |

*The table rows above come from Tables 3a–3e in the PDF, which present the national averages (the “Aust” row) and participation rate for each Year 7 domain in 2012.*

**Coverage**  
The page establishes the following 2012 Australia‑wide (national) data for Year 7:  

- For each of the five NAPLAN domains (Reading, Persuasive Writing, Spelling, Grammar and Punctuation, Numeracy) the national mean scale score and participation rate.  
- The data set is complete for **2012** only and is limited to the “Aust” (national) row; state‑level rows exist but are not needed for the current evidence.

**Missing**  
The page does **not** contain:  

- 2022 Australia‑wide NAPLAN results (average scores or participation rates).  
- Any comparison of 2012 with 2022, i.e., improvement figures.
